description: This source file implements the Python code serialization for TorchScript, including functions for printing functions, classes, and nodes, as well as managing dependencies and constants for exporting models.

classes.name: PrintDepsTable
classes.description: Manages dependencies of named types such as classes, functions, and enums used during serialization.

classes.name: PythonPrintImpl
classes.description: Implements the core logic for printing Python code from TorchScript nodes, including handling of nodes, blocks, dependencies, and constants.

methods.name: printNamedType
methods.description: Prints the Python representation of a named type, such as classes, functions, or tuples.

methods.name: printFunction
methods.description: Prints a TorchScript function as Python code.

methods.name: printMethod
methods.description: Prints a method of a class as Python code.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Returns the generated Python code as a string.

methods.name: ranges
methods.description: Returns source range information for the generated code.

methods.name: minVersion
